![المصداقية](/_layouts/15/CCHIPortal/ThemeAssets/assets/images/link-icon.svg)

## Official Saudi Government website URL end with .gov.sa 

Website belongs to an official government organizaton in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia always ends with .gov.sa.

![الأمان](/_layouts/15/CCHIPortal/ThemeAssets/assets/images/square-lock-password.svg)

## Official Secure websites use HTTPS  for encryption and security

Secured governments websites in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia use Https encryption.

![هيئة الحكومة الرقمية](/_layouts/15/CCHIPortal/ThemeAssets/assets/images/DGA-logo-icon.svg)
